objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the request method override flaw to run a command on the ThinkPHP server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Look at how ThinkPHP 5.0's Request class decides which method it is handling, and which methods a request may name.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which PHP framework, and which version, serves the site? (name and version)

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which request parameter overrides the HTTP method? (parameter name)

steps.title: Find the class
steps.prompt: Which framework class handles that override? (class name)

steps.title: Name the outcome
steps.prompt: What does the flaw give an attacker? (two words)
